Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.222 of 2023 at Police Station-Shikarpur, District-Bulandshahar under Sections 406, 376, 506 IPC.
The applicant is in jail since 21.06.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 07.07.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Sushil Dubey, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Vipin vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107441643/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The victim and the applicant were intimate and had a consensual physical relationship for past many years.
2. FIR is a result of the relationship between the applicant and the victim going awry.
3. The applicant never gave a plighted word to marry with him.
4. The F.I.R. is being leveraged to force the applicant to marry with the victim.
5. Prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence.
6. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
7. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I contends that no instructions have been forthcoming.
Liberty of citizens is too sacrosanct and cannot be held to ransom by apathy of the police officials.
There is no cause for failing to provide instructions to the learned Government Advocate despite advance notice of the bail application.

The Superintendent of Police, Bulandshahar shall take appropriate action against the erring police officials for failing to send appropriate instructions to the learned Additional Government Advocate despite advance notice of bail application and violating the directions of this Court in Sahil Vs. State of U.P. (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 19839 of 2021) as well as in Aditya Dubey alias Sachin Vs. State of U.P. (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 17969 of 2022) and the consequential orders passed by the Director General of Police, Government of U.P, Lucknow.

sentences.text: In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Vipin be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
